name: dsh-cli-session
description: Safely inspect and prompt an already-running local DeepSeek Harness session.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect and prompt a live local DSH session.
interface.longDescription: DSH CLI Session provides a small, loopback-only tool surface for listing sessions, inspecting a selected session, and queueing or steering a prompt through an already-running DeepSeek Harness web session.
defaultPrompt: List the running local DSH sessions
Queue this prompt in my DSH session
